proof_body:
by
  intro R L M _ _ _ _ _ _ _ I J N
  rw [LieSubmodule.lie_le_iff]
  intro z hz m hm
  have hz' : z ∈ Submodule.span R {m : L | ∃ x ∈ I, ∃ n ∈ J, ⁅x, n⁆ = m} := by
    rw [← LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span']
    exact hz
  clear hz
  induction hz' using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [lie_lie]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (LieSubmodule.mem_sup_left (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie hx (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie hy hm))) (LieSubmodule.mem_sup_right (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie hy (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie hx hm)))
  | zero => simp
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    rw [add_lie]
    exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul r a _ ha =>
    rw [smul_lie]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r ha
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (L : Type*) (M : Type*) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] (I J : LieIdeal R L) (N : LieSubmodule R L M), ⁅⁅I, J⁆, N⁆ ≤ ⁅I, ⁅J, N⁆⁆ ⊔ ⁅J, ⁅I, N⁆⁆
